unit: one DCOIR Review run on one benchmark PR

quality_metrics.seeded_defect_recall: matched seeded defect IDs / total seeded defect IDs
quality_metrics.seeded_precision: findings matched to seeded defects / total findings after adjudicating legitimate extra true positives
quality_metrics.clean_region_false_positive_count: findings whose anchor/rationale targets an intentionally clean region
quality_metrics.clean_region_false_positive_rate: clean regions with >=1 unjustified finding / total clean regions
quality_metrics.extra_true_positive_count: legitimate non-seeded defects found and manually adjudicated true
quality_metrics.missed_seed_ids: seed IDs with no materially matching finding
quality_metrics.exact_anchor_rate: matched seed findings anchored inside the oracle anchor_lines / matched seed findings
quality_metrics.near_anchor_rate: matched seed findings outside anchor_lines but within the same seeded function/region / matched seed findings
quality_metrics.wrong_anchor_count: findings matched semantically to a seed but anchored to an unrelated region
quality_metrics.severity_distribution: count by reviewer severity for matched seeds
quality_metrics.severity_delta_by_seed: baseline vs post-merge severity category for each matched seed
quality_metrics.actionability_score: 0=no usable remediation, 1=directionally useful but incomplete, 2=specific and implementable
quality_metrics.duplicate_finding_count: findings materially duplicating another finding for the same root cause

reliability_and_efficiency_metrics.review_completed: boolean: workflow and review output completed successfully
reliability_and_efficiency_metrics.usable_evidence: boolean: enough artifacts/comments exist to score the run
reliability_and_efficiency_metrics.openrouter_request_count: capture when exposed by debug/telemetry artifacts
reliability_and_efficiency_metrics.review_failure_stage: null on success; otherwise terminal stage/error class

comparison_rules.payload_equivalence: paired A/B fixture SHA-256 must match exactly
comparison_rules.recall_regression: post-merge misses any seed detected by baseline without explicit justified policy reason
comparison_rules.false_positive_regression: post-merge adds unjustified findings in oracle clean regions
comparison_rules.anchor_regression: post-merge materially worsens anchor accuracy for the same seed
comparison_rules.actionability_regression: post-merge actionability score decreases for the same seed
comparison_rules.reliability_regression: post-merge run fails or loses usable evidence when baseline succeeded
comparison_rules.efficiency_note: compare duration/request/token/cost metrics when both rounds expose them; do not treat unavailable baseline telemetry as zero
